title: Zesty Canadian Salmon Wrap
description: A funky and chewy Canadian dish featuring dijon mustard and salmon, perfect for a brunch mood, macrobiotic friendly and made with leaf wrap steam method
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
Season the salmon fillet with salt and pepper
In a small bowl mix dijon mustard and lemon juice
Brush the mixture on the salmon fillet
Place the salmon on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper
Bake the salmon for 12 minutes or until cooked through
While the salmon is cooking prepare the quinoa and vegetable filling
In a large bowl mix cooked quinoa, red onion, carrots, and celery
Once the salmon is done let it cool for a few minutes
To assemble the wrap place a collard green leaf on a flat surface
Place a quarter of the quinoa mixture on the center of the leaf
Slice the salmon into thin pieces and place on top of the quinoa mixture
